summary: A collection of Windows-based network programming examples demonstrating UDP broadcast communication and TCP client-server architecture, built with C++17 and the WinSock2 API.
key_features: UDP broadcast chat with background listener thread
Non-blocking console UI with dynamic message rendering
Graceful connection handling and error detection
achievements: Implemented asynchronous UDP message listening using std::thread and CreateThread to prevent blocking the main CLI input stream. Engineered a non-blocking console UI with dynamic message rendering using ANSI escape sequences and Windows terminal flags. Developed robust WinSock2 lifecycle management with proper socket configuration (SO_BROADCAST, inet_pton) and graceful TCP disconnect/error handling. Structured the project with CMake for cross-compiler compatibility while maintaining Windows-specific API integration.
